name: generator-power-advisor
description: **Know what you can safely run.** An installable, offline-capable Progressive Web App (PWA) that turns a portable generator's real-world capacity — running load, largest startup surge, elevation derating, and remaining fuel — into a clear **Safe / Near Capacity / Unsafe** answer, the reason behind it, and what to change.

scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.open:ios: npm run sync:ios && npx cap open ios
